name: Prepare, review and export the fictional voice example
covers: source and recipient changes revoke approval
description: Verifies the reliable core demonstration with consent and approval controls.
steps: Open the root Letter Studio page; recording and processing must be disabled without permission.
Load fictional visit, play audio, check permission and choose Use prepared example transcript.
Verify transcript, fields and letter show Alex Morgan, six weeks, and the missing radiograph. The status explicitly identifies a fixed prepared example.
Verify approval/export are blocked before review; acknowledge unresolved information and confirm complete review and recipient. Approve and export TXT and HTML.
Change the recipient or transcript; verify approval and export are blocked until preparation and checks are repeated.
expected: Fictional audio and labelled prepared fields produce an editable letter; both export types unlock only for an approved current version, and edits revoke approval.

name: Transcribe audio and extract corrected transcript with AI
description: Verifies both AI endpoints through their useful rendered output.
steps: Load fictional visit on the root page, confirm permission, then choose Prepare report from recording.

Wait for the AI response; verify a nonempty transcript of the visit, clinical fields and editable report. Verify six-week review and the radiograph request are preserved, without an invented appointment date.
Correct the transcript by adding Specialist: Please ask the referring practice to telephone our office. Then choose Prepare report from this transcript.
Verify the transcript preserves the correction and report fields reflect explicit source wording; no approval is automatically granted.
expected: Both audio and text AI routes display useful source-grounded output, preserve unknowns and leave specialist approval outstanding.

name: Recover from voice AI failure on mobile and reset the case
covers: microphone permission or unsupported browser recovery
description: Verifies the visible retry/fallback path and mobile case cleanup.
steps: Open the root page on mobile; load the fictional visit and confirm permission. Try Record visit, then Stop if browser permission is available. If permission is unavailable, verify the message offers the sample path.
Reload the fictional visit, confirm permission and prepare the report from the recording.
Verify the AI error preserves audio and offers a prepared example; use that fallback and verify a draft appears.
Turn permission off and verify recording/processing are disabled. Reset demo and verify transcript, audio, case details, draft and approval are cleared.
expected: All controls fit mobile; capture either works or explains recovery; an AI failure preserves the sample and permits a clearly labelled fallback; reset removes voice/case content.

name: Interpret an approved recipient brief and revise safely
covers: B specialist review and recipient checks
B full report and local observation
description: Verifies recipient comprehension and the approved-version boundary.
steps: Navigate to B.html and open specialist review. Generate the sample draft.
Try approval without both checks and verify it is blocked; then confirm report review and recipient and approve this version.
Simulate the practice handoff. Identify Cedar Grove Dental as the office that shares the earlier radiograph before the specialist review in six weeks. Open the full approved report.
Return to specialist review and create a revision or edit a field; verify the new revision requires approval and cannot replace the already approved recipient version silently.
expected: The approved recipient brief and full report agree on action, owner and timing; unapproved edits require new review.

name: Move a coordinator case through specialist approval and export
covers: C approved export and simulated return
description: Verifies team handoff states and blocked preparation when the source is missing.
steps: Navigate to C.html. As coordinator, select the case in Prepare, inspect existing notes, check source and proposed recipient, then prepare the draft.
Verify the coordinator cannot approve. Switch to specialist, inspect the draft, confirm clinical review and current recipient, and approve.
Switch back to coordinator, export the approved report, then simulate return. Verify the returned state.
Select the missing-note case and verify preparation and export remain blocked.
Open Overview, Guide and Prompt history; verify navigation to all prototypes and five attributed initial exchanges per prototype are accessible.
expected: Only the specialist demo role approves; the coordinator exports the approved snapshot; missing notes and another case cannot reuse approval, and the support pages remain accessible.
